about: Floors for tests/test_eval.py and run_eval.py, set to the values measured on 2026-09-29 (the search is deterministic, so they are exact). They apply to the dev split only (cases with split "dev"); held-out test cases have no floors. Raise a floor when search improves; never lower one without a reason in CHANGELOG.md. false 'exists' must always be 0 and is checked separately.
